title: Megurine Luka — Their Music Video〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think the girls are already at the festival venue?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they said that they'd arrive around this time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we take a peek?
We'll need to make sure we don't get seen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So many people. This is the festival venue?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Looks like it...
The sign over there even says, “Jam Fest”.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, is it just me or is this phone placed at a weird angle?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think we're inside one of their pockets.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Let's see... Ichika and the girls are...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Watching the show.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They haven't noticed us yet...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<In that case, let's not bother them.
We can keep watching quietly from here.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, the stage they're gonna perform on is huge! How cool would it be if we got to play somewhere like here?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, it'd be so much fun to play on such a big stage.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Not so loud, you two.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, right!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <A big stage...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What's wrong?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<This stage is so big that...
I'm worried it's going to make the girls really nervous...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <A big stage comes with big expectations, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Right...
But I'm sure they'll do just fine.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <After all, they practiced incredibly hard in preparation for this day.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <T-True! I'm also sure that they'll do just fine!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I am a little worried that they're gonna be startled by all the people here!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's their first big festival, after all. And they did say that they're a little nervous.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Female Attendee A
rows.Line: This is so cool! I can't believe my favorite band is playing at Jam Fest!

rows.Speaker: Female Attendee B
rows.Line: They haven't even started playing, but you look like you're ready to burst. We need to save our energy for later so that we're louder than the other stages!

rows.Speaker: Male Attendee A
rows.Line: Wow, I wasn't expecting much from the rookie stage, but these bands are pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Male Attendee B
rows.Line: Didn't I tell you? I've been looking for some new bands to follow, so I knew we had to come here.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Thanks for providing us with so much amazing energy!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: I know most of you are hearing this song for the first time, but we promise to keep things super fun until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I don't think we need to worry.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know they're nervous, but I'm sure they'll get to have some genuine fun.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I mean, this place is overflowing with powerful feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Powerful feelings...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. Some are here today to cheer on their favorite bands, while others are here to enjoy the stage as a whole...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And a few are hoping to encounter music that they haven't before.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As for the musicians, they're doing their best to reach everyone, including those who are seeing them perform for the first time...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Right.
You can hear all their thoughts...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Exactly. I'm sure that they'll stop feeling nervous the second they step into this sea of emotions.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Because the girls also want to connect with them.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<You're right.
I'm sure Ichika and them will succeed.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Me too! I know they're gonna put on a super amazing show!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, let's all just sit back and enjoy.>
